subject: Renewal & expansion: volume step-ups, blended rates, adding new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@stellarretail.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's call — volume ranges & target $/1M tokens

Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our conversation so we have shared alignment:

Summary of what you said:
- Current usage (pilot): ~12M tokens/month across chat routes (customer support + personalization).
- Expected growth: 3x over next 6 months as you roll out new personalization route and add product Q&A.
- Target budget: looking to land at roughly $6k–$9k/month budget for inference initially; long-term target economics ~ $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (net) is what finance is comfortable exploring.
- Must support two additional routes: personalization (higher ctx lengths) and store-assistant (lower latency). Also interested in adding an embedding route for search later this year.

Initial pricing thoughts (ballpark):
- If committed to 50M+ tokens/month we can offer step-up blended rates that land near your target economics.
- Example: 0–10M: $3.20/1k tokens; 10–50M: $2.10/1k; 50M+: $1.45/1k — blended rates depend on committed volumes and model mix (chat vs embeddings).

Next steps we agreed:
1) I will send a short pricing sketch (attached) that shows a few step-up commitments and blended monthly spends.
2) You and Jessica (procurement) will confirm a comfy budget band and whether Stellar can commit to a 6 or 12 month reserved tier.
3) David will review technical questions around route isolation and latency SLOs; Neha will be looped for onboarding/timelines after terms are agreed.

Attachments: pricing sketch (2026-04-18-stellar-pricing-proposal.xlsx) and a short blended-rate memo (redwood-blended-rate-memo.pdf).

Would love confirmation of the budget band and rough preferred commitment term by end of day Tuesday so we can draft a formal quote.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

---
Attachment: 2026-04-18-stellar-pricing-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
Attachment: redwood-blended-rate-memo.pdf (1 page)
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Ho <jessica.ho@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's call — volume ranges & target $/1M tokens

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side:

- Budget band: We're comfortable exploring the $7k–$9k/month band to start, with the expectation that we will scale. Finance prefers a 12-month committed plan if the unit economics are close to what we discussed.
- Volume assumptions: Pilot month is ~12M; Q3 targets ~35–40M; by Q4 we could be north of 60M depending on feature rollouts.
- Model mix: chat ~85% tokens, embeddings ~15% once search is live. For chat we will primarily use a mid-sized open model (similar to MPT/Redwood-verified) with occasional higher-capacity runs for longer context personalization.
- SLA: Latency target for store-assistant is sub-200ms p95; personalization can tolerate higher p95 but needs consistency.

Jessica: can you confirm procurement timeline and if Stellar can sign a 12-month commitment once the SOW and pricing look OK?

I can confirm next week on exact volume commit preference. Thanks — Alex
Head of AI Platforms | Stellar Retail
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@stellarretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's call — volume ranges & target $/1M tokens

Alex — quick technical notes from our end after reviewing the routes you described:
- Route isolation: we can pin personalization and store-assistant to separate routes with dedicated batching profiles to meet the different latency/throughput needs.
- Throughput: with 50–60M tokens/month we recommend a dedicated pool (Redwood Dedicated) to guarantee latency SLOs; otherwise, hosted with route fallback works but may have variable p95 under peak.
- Model variants: we can register a baseline mid-sized open model + an optimized quantized variant for high-volume inference to hit the lower $/1M targets. Blended rates will incorporate model mix %s.

I'll draft a short note on expected p95 vs cost at the volume breakpoints and share by EOD. Neha — looping you for onboarding windows (2–3 weeks after contract signature) and any security/compliance checklists needed for a dedicated deployment.

-David
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@stellarretail.com>, Jessica Ho <jessica.ho@stellarretail.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing sketch (updated) + ask for preferred commitment term

Alex/Jessica — attaching an updated pricing sketch that translates your volume corridors into blended $/1M token figures. Key scenarios included:

Scenario A — 12-month 25M committed avg: blended $/1M = $1,900
Scenario B — 12-month 50M committed avg: blended $/1M = $1,350
Scenario C — 12-month 75M committed avg + model optimization: blended $/1M = $980

Notes:
- These assume chat:embeddings split of 85:15. If embeddings rollout is slower, blended improves for chat-heavy months.
- We can include a 3-month ramp credit in the first quarter to smooth initial spend for you.
- Adding a new route (embeddings) has a small one-time onboarding fee reflected in the SOW; operationally it's quick but we include it for procurement visibility.

Can you confirm whether you prefer Scenario A/B/C as a starting point and whether Stellar would sign a 12-month term? If you prefer a 6-month trial, we can show a higher blended rate but with an option to convert to a 12-month commitment with true-ups.

If acceptable, I'll have our legal team prep a draft SOW + order form and route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Jessica Ho <jessica.ho@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing sketch (updated) + ask for preferred commitment term

Thanks Marissa — we like Scenario B as the baseline (50M, 12-month). A few asks from procurement:
- Please provide a clear PO-ready order form with line items (monthly commit, one-time onboarding, support add-on).
- Can you confirm the blended $/1M formula and provide example monthly invoices for months 1, 3, 6, 12 under Scenario B? That will help finance sign off.

If you can get the draft order form + example invoice by end of this week, we can aim to issue a PO early next week.

-Jessica
Procurement Manager | Stellar Retail
